sentences.japanese: 近くにお越しの際はぜひお立ち寄りください。
sentences.english: Please drop in when you happen to be in the neighborhood.

sentences.japanese: 緊急の際には、すぐに私の代理人と連絡を取って下さい。
sentences.english: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent right away.

sentences.japanese: 狂気の状態の際に、善悪を区別させようとしても無駄である。
sentences.english: It is no use trying to separate the sheep from the goats while in a state of madness.

sentences.japanese: お着きの際は、ご連絡ください。
sentences.english: Let us know when you'll arrive.

sentences.japanese: 記者会見の際、大統領は外交関係にちょっと触れた。
sentences.english: During the press conference, the President touched on foreign relations.
